title: KillTimer
description: A mod that adds a timer to your game that kills you when the time is up.
body:
## Information

This mod kills you when the timer is up

## Usage

### Default settings
- When you join a game the timer will automatically start on 10:00

### Commands
- `///startkilltimer [minutes]`: the mod will start a timer with the specified time
- `///stopkilltimer`: the mod will stop the running timer and reset it to 00:00

### Screenshots
